title: Spanish Feta Pa Amb Tomaquet
description: A winey and tender Spanish dish featuring cubed feta cheese, perfect for a hangover cure, made with a papillote method and diabetic-friendly ingredients. This traditional Catalan recipe is a twist on the classic pa amb tomaquet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the red wine, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed feta cheese to the bowl and toss to coat with the wine mixture.
Arrange the diced tomatoes on a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil, leaving a small border around the edges.
Place the coated feta cheese on top of the tomatoes, then sprinkle with minced garlic.
Fold the parchment paper or aluminum foil over the feta cheese and tomatoes to create a papillote, sealing the edges by folding or twisting.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the crusty bread into thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
Rub the toasted bread with garlic and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the toasted bread with the winey feta cheese and tomatoes, spooning some of the juices over the top.
